pro_description.value: (Action, 15ft radius sphere) You create a 15ft Sphere in a point within 30ft of you, and move that sphere 30ft in a straight line away from you. Any creatures or objects who come in contact with this sphere automatically take 50 points of force damage. If a creature or object is reduced to zero hit points in this way, they disintegrate and nothing of them is left behind. You cannot use this ability again until you take a long rest. While using this ability you are not considered blind.

con_description.value: When you use this ability, reduce your Intelligence Score and Constitution Score by 2, you gain 2 levels of exhaustion and one permanent madness until you take a long rest.
